            (header_height + 8.0),

name: examples/counter/Counter.gogo
source:
extends EstragonSurface

var count: int = 0


func _init() -> void:
    set_root(build_view())


func increment() -> void:
    count += 1
    set_root(build_view())


func reset_count() -> void:
    count = 0
    set_root(build_view())


func build_view() -> EstragonVBox:
    return (
        <VBox gap={12}>
            <Text text="Estragon Gogo Counter" font_size="26" color="#bba2ef" />
            <Text text={"Count: %d" % count} font_size={24} />
            <HBox gap="12" fill_width="true">
                <Button text="+" fill_width="true" pressed={increment} />
                <Button text="Reset" fill_width="true" disabled={count == 0} pressed={reset_count} />
            </HBox>
            <Text text="Gogo generates the signal connections. Explicit rebuild; automatic cleanup." font_size="16" />
        </VBox>
    )
